content.title: TFC Tidbits: Injury rules out Benjamin Kuscevic vs. Austin
content.text: In-depth analysis and commentary on Toronto FC, Canada's original MLS club Welcome to TFC Tidbits, a special feature at TFC Republic that curates bits and pieces of news about what's going on with Toronto FC. Chilean centre back dealing with a groin injuryToronto FC coach Robin Fraser has made two lineup changes from last week's game for Saturday afternoon's home tilt against Austin FC.Drafting in for TFC are fullbacks Kobe Franklin and Raheem Edwards, with centre back Benjamin Kuscevic and fullback Matheus Pereira both making way due to groin injuries.
